about: Zenodo (CERN's open research repository). This CLI searches communities and the records inside them, and fetches record metadata, versions, formatted citations, citing works, community members, subcommunities and collection records.

commands.summary: Search or list records (datasets, software, publications…) inside a community by keyword, with resource-type and access filters, sorting and pagination

params.name: community_id
params.description: Community UUID (the 'id' field from search-communities or get-record-communities)

params.name: q
params.description: Keyword query. Elasticsearch/Lucene syntax is allowed, e.g. metadata.title:galaxy. Empty lists all records.

params.name: resource_type
params.description: Filter by resource type id, e.g. dataset, software, publication, image, video, poster, presentation, lesson, other

params.name: allversions
params.description: Include all versions of each record, not only the latest

commands.summary: Search or browse Zenodo communities by keyword, with a community-type filter, sorting and pagination

params.name: q
params.description: Keyword query. Empty lists all communities.

commands.summary: List the communities currently featured on Zenodo's home and communities pages
Get a record's full metadata (title, creators, description, DOI, license, files, stats) as JSON, using the record's JSON export

params.name: record_id
params.description: Numeric Zenodo record id, e.g. 23448934 (the number in zenodo.org/records/{id})

commands.summary: List the communities a record belongs to
List all versions of a record, ordered by version

params.name: record_id
params.description: Numeric Zenodo record id (any version of the record)

commands.summary: Get a formatted bibliography citation for a record in a chosen citation style (APA, Harvard, MLA, Vancouver, Chicago, IEEE)
List works that cite a Zenodo record, looked up by the record's concept (parent) DOI through the Zenodo citation broker

params.name: doi
params.description: Parent/concept DOI of the record (links.parent_doi without the https://doi.org/ prefix), e.g. 10.5281/zenodo.592536

commands.summary: List the public members of a community

params.name: community_id
params.description: Community UUID (the 'id' field from search-communities or get-record-communities)

commands.summary: List the subcommunities of a parent community, e.g. the EU Open Research Repository or the Biodiversity Literature Repository
List or search the records in a community collection (e.g. Biodiversity Literature Repository taxon collections) by numeric collection id

params.name: collection_id
params.description: Numeric collection id, e.g. 63 (Tyrannosaurus rex in biosyslit)

commands.summary: Search across all Zenodo records with an Elasticsearch/Lucene query, e.g. by title, creator, community id or related identifiers

params.name: q
params.description: Elasticsearch/Lucene query over record fields (metadata.title, metadata.creators.person_or_org.name, parent.communities.ids, metadata.related_identifiers.identifier, …), e.g. parent.communities.ids:<u
